about_the_game:
🔥 Spin the Fire – A Spinning Deckbuilding Roguelike 🔥

In Spin the Fire, your cards revolve around a flickering campfire, and so does your fate. Every turn, the fire shifts, your choices rotate, and the battle evolves. Manage your flame-powered resource wisely—let it burn too bright, and you'll be left in ashes; let it fade, and the darkness will consume you.

Inspired by Ring of Pain and Pyrene (and definitely NOT Slay the Spire), Spin the Fire brings a unique twist to roguelike deckbuilding.

🔥 Key Features 🔥

🌀 A New Kind of Deckbuilder – Cards spin around the fire, up to you to mix and refill the cards your delt, at your own risk !
🔥 Flame Management – Your fire is your lifeline. Keep it fueled to survive, but don’t let it consume you !
💀 Roguelike Intensity – Face relentless enemies, make tough decisions, and build the perfect deck to survive.
🎶 A Killer Soundtrack – Composed by the talented Jérémie Frémont (Mod:e) to keep the heat alive.
✨ VFX Magic – Featuring stunning effects from Cartoon Coffee’s Mega Pack.
🎨 Handcrafted with Passion – Designed, programmed, and illustrated by aznoqmous in under a month for Boss Rush Jam 2025 (theme: SPIN).

Wishlist now and prepare to enter the flames! 🔥🔥🔥

🔥 Content 🔥

The demo now includes :

3 playable characters

30 equipment cards

20 enemies

5 foliage cards

3 zones with their own boss(es) and soundtrack

and more to come !

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 14.04 LTS
  • Processor: 2.0 Ghz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1Gb Video Memory, capable of OpenGL 3.0+ support (2.1 with ARB extensions acceptable)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
